subject: gov.regional
name: Common regional framework for regulating social media
milestone: National consultation held 2 September 2026
position_end: The communication, digital economy and administrative modernisation ministry convened digital and media actors on 2 September 2026 to weigh a common regional alliance framework for regulating social media, chaired by the ministry's secretary-general and attended by the online-press association, the data-protection authority, the national cybercrime unit and the communications authority. A reference framework developed in Burkina Faso was put forward as the model: built on legality, proportionality, transparency, shared responsibility and respect for freedom of expression, it distinguishes illicit from merely harmful and from protected content - preserving satire, political criticism, debate of general interest and investigative journalism from disproportionate restriction - and would require platforms to offer simple, accessible reporting mechanisms, differentiated processing deadlines, reasoned moderation decisions and retention of removed content as evidence
note: the model framework's protections are unusually explicit for this base and the enforcement half is not described: no instrument, adopting body, timetable or means of binding platforms outside the region is stated
